description: Before spending credits, call quote_generation and explain the returned price or unknown total. For a known quote, obtain approval and pass max_credits. For an unknown total, obtain explicit acceptance and pass accept_unknown_cost:true without max_credits. Never switch consent modes or remove or raise a ceiling without new user approval. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Use this when the user wants to edit one existing image with a text instruction. Upload the image with upload_image first. Flow: list_models(type=image_edit) -> get_model_help -> edit_image -> get_task_status with the returned batch_id. For a new image without a source, use generate_image. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: Set true only after the user explicitly accepts an unknown total, without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; this does not enforce a total budget.

custom_resolution.description: Use a custom resolution when the model supports it.

image.description: Image URL to edit, usually from upload_image.

max_credits.description: User-approved ceiling for a known current quote. Cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run. Never remove or raise it without new user consent.

output_format.description: Output format when the model supports it, for example png or webp.

quality.description: Image quality when the model supports it, for example low, medium, high.

resolution.description: Image resolution when the model supports it.

size.description: Image size or aspect ratio when the model supports it, for example 1024x1024 or 16:9.

name: edit_image

batch_id.description: Open RPC batch ID for get_task_status.

success.description: Whether the batch request was accepted by Freebeat.
